scope: Independent rendered design review, no application source edits
method: Fresh isolated local Chromium process; 1440x1000 desktop and 390x844 mobile at DPR 1; actual scrolling before full captures; images opened with view_image. Earlier shared-browser captures had inherited 90% zoom and are superseded.
verdict: The desktop composition is cohesive and specific to the brief. Warm paper, umber, clay, Newsreader and Instrument Sans form a strong editorial system. Varanasi photography and asymmetry distinguish it from a generic travel catalog. No horizontal body overflow at either final tested viewport.

findings.finding: Mobile hero is visibly soft because sizes=100vw selects a 640px landscape image while object-fit:cover in a 390x743 box renders it roughly 1320px wide.
findings.recommendation: Provide a dedicated portrait crop or cover-aware mobile sizes (approximately 160vh for the existing 88svh hero). Source asset is 2400x1348 and contains more usable detail.

findings.finding: At 390px the planning heading leaves 'a' alone on a line before 'conversation.'.
findings.recommendation: Reduce mobile planning heading from 68px to approximately 60–61px or adjust responsive width/size so 'a conversation.' remains together.

findings.finding: Generated photo alt text inherits the first destination highlight. This incorrectly labels Rumi Darwaza as Bara Imambara and Madan Mohan Temple as Banke Bihari.
findings.recommendation: Store explicit alt text by photo rather than deriving it from destination highlights.

findings.finding: Four full-width journey cards make this section approximately 3242px tall on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Consider reducing mobile journey-photo height from 365px to 285–300px while preserving complete route and duration information.

findings.finding: Initial mobile DOM joined Beforeyou after the desktop line break was hidden. Root added separating whitespace during the review; the corrected phrase was visually confirmed.
Root replaced the first-light wording with EVENING ON THE GANGA, VARANASI, consistent with the sunset photo provenance.

positiveChecks: Desktop hero keeps genuine location detail visible behind the headline.
Trip finder has clear field hierarchy and a strong single action.
The Varanasi feature is well balanced, with a deliberate inset photo and generous whitespace.
Destination rail correctly reveals a next-card edge on mobile.
Journey metadata and calls to action align across the desktop grid.
Mobile planner form labels and side-by-side fields remain aligned.
Fonts load, and the two-family hierarchy is consistent throughout.
All vertically encountered image assets loaded; off-screen horizontal rail images remain lazily deferred, which is expected.
limitations: Root was actively editing during the review, so report findings describe the captured state and may already be fixed.
This review evaluated visual design and geometry. Parent is responsible for the full interaction regression pass.
Some screenshot anchors center long sections, so viewport captures begin partway through those sections; full-page final screenshots preserve the complete layout.
